goal.name: Python
goal.video_language_note: Every topic has an English video; Hindi videos are available for Phases 1–3. Phases 4–5 are English-only (tagged).
career_outcomes: Build CLI apps, scrapers and simple APIs
Analyse data with Pandas and plot charts
Next roadmaps: Backend, Data Science, AI/ML
goal.resource_policy: Links only to free, legal sources (official bodies, open-licence textbooks, reputable free platforms, public YouTube videos). No copyrighted PDFs re-hosted. YouTube videos are never paywalled or ad-gated.

estimated_hours.note: Planning estimate. Video minutes are estimates until the link checker fills real durations (+15% rule applied in-app).
